decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component system extends WIWA's core corrosion-protection spraying competence into a specialised niche at low incremental cost, and the firm's slack and the growing industry give no shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.
The low-pressure injection pump has its own page and a documented field test on a construction site, so it meets aspirations in the construction repair segment and is close to the established offer.

This multi-model transfer pump line reuses the proven WIWA air motors and fits core material-conveying applications, so its results are likely satisfactory and dropping it would release few resources.

Fire protection flow monitoring supports the firm's digitalisation and interoperability goals and still has its own page, so with organisational slack the firm can carry it while its results remain uncertain.
The hydraulic two-component system was launched only in 2024 and sits close to the core spraying portfolio, so it is too early for a shortfall against aspirations to justify dropping it.
